arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK030. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Right-facing upright head at a thin white waterline. Keep one visible eye looking toward the tongue, grinning mouth with triangular teeth, and a LONG thin pink tongue extending out to the RIGHT with its tip curled upward beyond the snout. This is a licking phase, not just an open grin. Hidden lower body/tail remain absent. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
